# WRIA 13 — Spurgeon Equus Barrier Correction

This 360 degree tour documents construction of the fish passage barrier replacement at Equus Road on Spurgeon Creek, a high priority tributary to the Deschutes River in WRIA 13. The site (WDFW FPDSI: 115 TC129) replaces an existing partial barrier identified through SPSSEG's 2021 WRIA 13 Barrier Inventory and Prioritization, located immediately upstream of the Thurston County barrier corrections completed in 2022 at Latigo Street and the Chehalis Western Trail crossing.

Work involves removing the existing undersized crossing and installing a prefabricated bridge structure sized to pass the natural channel and floodplain. Once complete, the project opens nearly one mile of high quality spawning and rearing habitat upstream. In-stream work is being completed within the approved fish window, with site planting to follow in winter and spring.

Live site: [All tours](https://alex-spsseg.github.io/wria13_SpurgeonEquusBarrierCorrection/tours.html)
